verdict.rationale: Automation rules are a fair question for a payments platform, but the pack documents no user-definable rules engine that triggers actions on events. What it does show doesn't qualify: Connect webhooks are a developer building block for constructing your own automation; automatic payout schedules are a recurring schedule, not event-triggered rules; and automatic payout splits and no-code pricing tools are fixed or adjacent features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
